name: Pagination
summary: Navigation between the pages of a long list or table, with Previous and Next.
use: Tables and search results with a fixed number of items per page.
avoid: Feeds where scrolling on makes more sense: think about "Load more".
figmaProps: Mobile shows "Page 1 of 10" instead of the numbers. In templates bound to layout-tokens/breakpoint/pagination.
The text of the Mobile variant.
Current: a 2 px ring and background in the brand color.
reactProps: Screen reader name per number. Default 'Page 3'.
Name of the navigation. Default 'Pagination'. aria-label also works.
behaviour: Previous is off on page 1, Next on the last page. They keep focus (aria-disabled), so focus does not drop to the page when you reach the end.
Below 600px the numbers make way for the page status.
a11y: <nav> with an aria-label. Current page with aria-current="page".
The current page does not rely on color alone: its ring has at least 3:1 contrast with the page and with its own background (WCAG 1.4.11).
do: Show the total number of results nearby.
dont: Pagination with fewer than two pages.
